Rugby High Gloss Smart Ottoman Bed

The Rugby Bed combines a contemporary high-gloss frame with space-saving ottoman storage and useful technology built into its fixed headboard. Choose from White, Walnut, Grey or Black in Single, Double and King sizes.

Storage and smart features included

The gas-assisted mattress platform opens to reveal four divided under-bed storage sections. The headboard includes concealed compartments, warm LED lighting, integrated speakers, a wireless charging pad and USB charging ports.

What is included?

Each Rugby Bed includes the high-gloss bed frame, fixed smart headboard and ottoman lifting mechanism. Mattresses, bedside cabinets, bedding and decorative accessories are sold separately.
